_note: Draft English rendering of Saadia's JA Tafsir on Shemot 25, generated by scripts/translate_tafsir_english.py against the JA (not the biblical Hebrew). Translation goal: reverse-translatability for the Tafsir reader — readers should be able to map English back to JA. Saadia-specific moves preserved per data-source/saadia-gloss-table.json; Blau's notes (data-source/blau-genesis-notes.json) consulted for Bereshit 1-12.

translations.1: Then God spoke to Moses directly.
translations.2: Command the sons of Israel that they take for Me an raised-offering; from every man whose soul is generous — you shall take My raised-offering.
translations.3: And this is the raised-offering which you shall take from them: gold, and silver, and copper;
translations.4: and blue, and purple, and scarlet dye, and fine linen, and goat-hair;
translations.5: and the skins of tanned rams, and the skins of tahash, and the wood of the acacia-tree;
translations.6: and oil for lighting, and spices for the anointing oil, and the incense of resins;
translations.7: crystal stones, and stones for setting — for the breastpiece and for the vestment.
translations.8: And they shall make for Me, from all of these, a sanctuary; and I shall settle My light in their midst.
translations.9: According to all that I am showing you — of the form of the tabernacle and the form of all its vessels — so shall you make it.
translations.10: And they shall make a chest of acacia wood: two cubits and a half its length, and a cubit and a half its width, and a cubit and a half its height.
translations.11: And overlay it with pure gold — from within it and from without it; and make upon it a rim of gold, going around.
translations.12: And cast for it four rings of gold, and place them on its four sides: two rings on the one side, and two rings on the second side.
translations.13: And make poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold.
translations.14: And insert the poles into the rings on the sides of the chest, to carry it by them.
translations.15: In the rings of the chest shall the poles remain — they shall not be removed from it.
translations.16: And place in the chest the testimony which I shall give you.
translations.17: And make a cover of pure gold: two cubits and a half its length, and a cubit and a half its width.
translations.18: And make two cherubim of gold — solid shall you make them — from the two ends of the cover.
translations.19: And make them: a cherub from this end and a cherub from this end; from the cover itself shall you make the cherubim, from its two ends.
translations.20: And the cherubim shall be spreading their wings upward, and overshadowing with them the cover; and the face of the one toward the other, and toward the cover — thus shall their faces be.
translations.21: And place the cover upon the chest from above, after you have placed in the chest the testimony which I shall give you.
translations.22: And I shall be present there with you, and I shall speak to you from above the cover, from between the two cherubim which are upon the chest of the testimony — with all that I command you to the sons of Israel.
translations.23: And make a table of acacia wood: two cubits its length, and a cubit its width, and a cubit and a half its height.
translations.24: And overlay it with pure gold, and make for it a rim of gold, going around.
translations.25: And make for it a border, the measure of a handbreadth, going around; and make a rim of gold for its border, going around.
translations.26: And cast for it four rings of gold, and place the rings at its four corners, which are opposite its four legs.
translations.27: Facing the border shall the rings be — as a place for the poles, by which to carry it.
translations.28: And make the poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold, so that the table may be carried by them.
translations.29: And make its dishes and its drawers, and its flagons and its ladles by which it is covered — of pure gold shall you make them.
translations.30: And place upon the table bread that is presented before Me continually.
translations.31: And make a lampstand of pure gold — solid shall the lampstand be made: its base and its shaft, and its cups, and its apples and its lilies shall be of it.
translations.32: Six branches going out from its sides: three branches from its one side, and three branches from its second side.
translations.33: Three almond-shaped cups in each branch — an apple and a lily; so for the six branches going out from it.
translations.34: And in the lampstand itself four almond-shaped cups — with their apples and their lilies.
translations.35: And an apple beneath each two branches from it — so for the six branches going out from it.
translations.36: Their apples and their shaft shall be of it — all of it one solid piece of pure gold.
translations.37: And make for it seven lamps; and when its lamps are lit, they shall give light toward the direction of its face.
translations.38: And its tongs and its fire-pans of pure gold.
translations.39: From a talent of pure gold shall he make it, and all these vessels.
translations.46: And look upon it and make it according to its form which you are shown on the mountain.
